integrity: The exact polynomial, support theorem, boundary cases, and minimum deletion multiplicities are stated with complete hypotheses. Numerical tests are not presented as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The all-parameter proof uses an explicit line-graph/star-forest bijection and labeled component enumeration; finite graph tests are corroborating only.
Prior-publication priority is provisional because unindexed or inaccessible enumerations cannot be excluded.
The result concerns vertex-induced cluster subgraphs and inclusion-minimal vertex deletions, not edge-deletion cluster editing.
title: Maximal induced cluster subgraphs of rook graphs: an exact enumerator and cardinality gaps
